name: app-long-target-audience-problem-solution-and-system-sheet
title: Audience, Problem and System Long Sheet
whatItIs: A tall pale sheet with a vertical HOW TO label, three portraits of target users with descriptor cards, problem and solution cards with statistics, and typography and colour system panels ending in a phone.
whatItMeans: Photos with clear cards make audience and problem statements human, and pale gradients keep the density calm.
techniques: Three portraits side by side beside descriptor cards
Red Problem and blue Solution headings for instant coding
Two rounded panels for type and colour systems
Vertical rotated label as a section marker

vocabulary.definition: A small card describing a user type.
Two adjacent cards contrasting an issue with the answer.
Text turned 90 degrees as a side marker.
